summary: Feedback request batch upload passed the approved non-browser tester scope after remediation. Source review confirmed duplicate headers are rejected, unsupported types are rejected, product fields are bounded, file names are sanitized, invalid calendar dates no longer fall through to permissive JavaScript date parsing, FeedbackBatch/Feedback persistence is modeled with unique link identifiers, and email delivery is server-only/mockable with sent/failed status tracking. Commands passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\feedback-request-batch-upload-source.test.mjs` with 22/22 passing. Browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email delivery were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
